tail:
**Batch 5 is authored.** I added five A-page items and two B-page examples, with the page entries, manifest, proof contracts, coverage, notes, cross-batch dependency records, and readiness records.

The energy theorem now proves separate Lorentz and Drude branches. The Drude dispersion proof constructs both the propagating mode above cutoff and the decaying mode below it. All seven assigned items have current Step 1 `ready` records; the two batch 4 prerequisites also have current ready records.

**Scoped checks passed:** precheck 7/7, proof layout 7 items with 24 steps and 0 defects, rendercheck 9 files, content policy 7 items with 0 errors, strict proof contract 7/7, and focused dependency checks. Manifest integrity found all 258 owed pages with no scope drift. The batch dependency graph check passed for all 129 batches.

The Fitzpatrick node 99 fetch exhausted its five recovery retries. I recorded the failed route and alternatives; the relevant oscillator slides in [MIT OCW Lecture 22](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/6-007-electromagnetic-energy-from-motors-to-lasers-spring-2011/6434fa7aae0266ed6d40109d70c724f9_MIT6_007S11_lec22.pdf) now support the source context, while local proofs preserve mathematical coverage. Final source check: 5/6 fetched, 6/6 resolved with one documented drop.

**Review notes:** Coverage reports one low-yield warning: 5 of 23 harvested results became new items; the rest have explicit dispositions for later Alpha review. Unrestricted run-wide dependency and contract-coverage checks still encounter empty inventories in other batches. The populated batch 4–5 dependency check and isolated batch 5 contract-coverage check pass.
